propositions.name: organs_and_instincts_variable
propositions.quote: all organs and instincts are, in ever so slight a degree, variable
propositions.statement: All organs and instincts are, in ever so slight a degree, variable.

propositions.name: struggle_preserves_deviation
propositions.quote: there is a struggle for existence leading to the preservation of each profitable deviation of structure or instinct
propositions.statement: There is a struggle for existence that leads to the preservation of each profitable deviation of structure or instinct.

propositions.name: common_descent_within_groups
propositions.quote: All the individuals of the same species, and all the species of the same genus, or even higher group, must have descended from common parents
propositions.statement: All the individuals of the same species and all the species of the same genus or higher group must have descended from common parents.

propositions.name: intermediates_supplanted_and_exterminated
propositions.quote: the intermediate varieties will, in the long run, be supplanted and exterminated
propositions.statement: The intermediate varieties will, in the long run, be supplanted and exterminated by the more numerous allied forms.

propositions.name: geological_record_extremely_imperfect
propositions.quote: the geological record is far more imperfect than most geologists believe
propositions.statement: The geological record is far more imperfect than most geologists believe.

propositions.name: lapse_of_time_inappreciable
propositions.quote: the lapse of time has been so great as to be utterly inappreciable by the human intellect
propositions.statement: The lapse of time has been so great as to be utterly inappreciable by the human intellect.

propositions.name: all_species_have_changed
propositions.quote: geology plainly declares that all species have changed; and they have changed in the manner which my theory requires, for they have changed slowly and in a graduated manner
propositions.statement: Over long enough intervals of time, geology plainly declares that all species have changed, slowly and in a graduated manner.

propositions.name: variability_due_to_reproductive_system
propositions.quote: This seems to be mainly due to the reproductive system being eminently susceptible to changes in the conditions of life; so that this system, when not rendered impotent, fails to reproduce offspring exactly like the parent-form
propositions.statement: Variability under domestication is mainly due to the reproductive system being eminently susceptible to changes in the conditions of life.

propositions.name: struggle_from_geometrical_increase
propositions.quote: The struggle for existence inevitably follows from the high geometrical ratio of increase which is common to all organic beings
propositions.statement: The struggle for existence inevitably follows from the high geometrical ratio of increase common to all organic beings.

propositions.name: more_born_than_survive
propositions.quote: More individuals are born than can possibly survive. A grain in the balance will determine which individual shall live and which shall die
propositions.statement: More individuals are born than can possibly survive, and a grain in the balance determines which individual shall live and which shall die.

propositions.name: species_are_permanent_varieties
propositions.quote: species are only strongly marked and permanent varieties, and that each species first existed as a variety
propositions.statement: Species are only strongly marked and permanent varieties, and each species first existed as a variety.

propositions.name: divergence_of_character_preserved
propositions.quote: there will be a constant tendency in natural selection to preserve the most divergent offspring of any one species
propositions.statement: There will be a constant tendency in natural selection to preserve the most divergent offspring of any one species.

propositions.name: grouping_inexplicable_by_creation
propositions.quote: This grand fact of the grouping of all organic beings seems to me utterly inexplicable on the theory of creation
propositions.statement: The grand fact of the grouping of all organic beings in groups subordinate to groups seems utterly inexplicable on the theory of creation.

propositions.name: selection_acts_by_slight_steps
propositions.quote: As natural selection acts solely by accumulating slight, successive, favourable variations, it can produce no great or sudden modification; it can act only by very short and slow steps
propositions.statement: Natural selection acts solely by accumulating slight, successive, favourable variations, and can produce no great or sudden modification.

propositions.name: use_and_disuse_produces_effect
propositions.quote: In both varieties and species, use and disuse seem to have produced some effect
propositions.statement: In both varieties and species, use and disuse seem to have produced some effect on structure.

propositions.name: extinction_follows_from_selection
propositions.quote: The extinction of species and of whole groups of species, which has played so conspicuous a part in the history of the organic world, almost inevitably follows on the principle of natural selection
propositions.statement: The extinction of species and whole groups almost inevitably follows on the principle of natural selection, for old forms will be supplanted by new and improved forms.

propositions.name: generation_never_broken
propositions.quote: Neither single species nor groups of species reappear when the chain of ordinary generation has once been broken
propositions.statement: Neither single species nor groups of species reappear when the chain of ordinary generation has once been broken.

propositions.name: affinities_from_community_of_descent
propositions.quote: The real affinities of all organic beings are due to inheritance or community of descent
propositions.statement: The real affinities of all organic beings are due to inheritance or community of descent.

propositions.name: natural_system_is_genealogical
propositions.quote: The natural system is a genealogical arrangement, in which we have to discover the lines of descent by the most permanent characters, however slight their vital importance may be
propositions.statement: The natural system is a genealogical arrangement, in which we discover lines of descent by the most permanent characters.

propositions.name: organism_to_organism_relation_most_important
propositions.quote: the relation of organism to organism is the most important of all relations
propositions.statement: The relation of organism to organism is the most important of all relations.

propositions.name: disuse_reduces_useless_organs
propositions.quote: Disuse, aided sometimes by natural selection, will often tend to reduce an organ, when it has become useless by changed habits or under changed conditions of life
propositions.statement: Disuse, aided sometimes by natural selection, will often tend to reduce an organ when it has become useless by changed habits or conditions of life.

propositions.name: animals_from_few_progenitors
propositions.quote: I believe that animals have descended from at most only four or five progenitors, and plants from an equal or lesser number
propositions.statement: Animals have descended from at most only four or five progenitors, and plants from an equal or lesser number.

propositions.name: life_from_one_primordial_form
propositions.quote: probably all the organic beings which have ever lived on this earth have descended from some one primordial form, into which life was first breathed
propositions.statement: Probably all organic beings which have ever lived on this earth have descended from some one primordial form into which life was first breathed.

propositions.name: no_clear_distinction_species_varieties
propositions.quote: no clear distinction has been, or can be, drawn between species and well-marked varieties
propositions.statement: No clear distinction has been, or can be, drawn between species and well-marked varieties.

propositions.name: species_slowly_changing_by_accumulation
propositions.quote: species have changed, and are still slowly changing by the preservation and accumulation of successive slight favourable variations
propositions.statement: Species have changed, and are still slowly changing, by the preservation and accumulation of successive slight favourable variations.
